newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ DMO defers decision on cutting 12-month T-bill.
newsitem.headline: NZ DMO defers decision on cutting 12-month T-bill.

text.p: The New Zealand Debt Management Office said on Monday it had deferred its decision regarding any reduction in the 12-month Treasury Bill.
The decision will be made after the 1997 Budget Policy Statement, when details of the new government's fiscal position will be available.
The DMO said the government's domestic bond tender programme for 1996/97, of NZ$1 billion of ordinary government bonds and $300 million of inflation-indexed bonds, remained unchanged.
The Reserve Bank will undertake some early repurchases of the July 1997 bond as part of its normal liquidity management, the DMO said. -- Wellington newsroom (64 4) 473 4746
